title: Presnt — Extracurricular Attendance & Compliance Platform
sub: Attendance tracking, dues, compliance, event management · 2025 → now
description: A full-stack mobile + web platform built for organizations to manage event attendance, member compliance, dues, and chapter oversight. Features passive geofence check-in, QR code scanning, role-based access, real-time notifications, and a multi-org hierarchy. Built end-to-end — Supabase schema with RLS, Express API, React Native mobile app, and a web dashboard.

title: CRRNT
sub: News + markets + AI insights, in your pocket · Apr 2026 → now
description: A mobile app that makes trending news feel personal — every story is paired with a relevant stock ticker, live price chart, and Claude-generated breakdowns of what it actually means for your rent, job, and wallet. Categories span Celebrity, Tech, Government, Sports, Business, Science, and Entertainment. Audio playback is generated on-demand via Fish Audio TTS, with personalized scripts for paid subscribers based on their city, job type, and financial goals. Built solo — design, all frontend screens, and a FastAPI backend that handles daily ingestion (NewsMesh + X/Twitter sentiment via GetXAPI), Claude enrichment (claude-haiku-4-5), RevenueCat subscriptions, Supabase Auth + Postgres, push notifications, an investment simulator, and a Jinja2 admin portal.

title: Mikayla's Weather Bot
sub: NYC daily-high forecasts vs. Kalshi markets · paper trading · 2026 → now
description: A weather-forecasting trading bot that pulls NWS forecasts and Kalshi KXHIGHNY market odds for NYC daily highs, compares model probability against market pricing, and paper-trades the edge on a schedule. Full-stack — FastAPI backend with scheduled ingestion/settlement crons, a Postgres store, and a Next.js dashboard for live weather, forecast drift, and simulated wallet performance.
